richard-black.name: Richard Black
richard-black.standfirst: A combat veteran and conservative Republican who has used Schiller Institute platforms to argue against war with Russia and for peace in Syria.
bio: Richard Black spent 32 years in uniform. As a Marine Corps helicopter pilot, Black flew 269 combat missions, then volunteered for ground combat with the 1st Marine Division and was wounded. A second career, as an Army lawyer, ended at the Pentagon as chief of the Criminal Law Division: testifying before Congress, preparing executive orders and advising the Senate Armed Services Committee. Two decades as a conservative voice in the Virginia House and Senate followed.

Since 2015 Black has spoken at Schiller Institute conferences in Paris, New York and Bad Soden and online: on the war in Syria, on sanctions, and on the danger of nuclear war. Xinhua and TASS have interviewed Black as a voice of the Institute.

jason-ross.standfirst: A scientist of economics: value lies in human discovery, and progress can be measured in the density of the energy a society commands.
bio: Jason Ross works where science meets economics. As a member of Lyndon LaRouche's science research team, known as “the Basement”, Ross has worked on the history of discovery from Kepler to Gauss and Riemann; on planetary defense, fusion power and helium-3 from the Moon; and on the biosphere and noösphere of the Russian-Ukrainian scientist Vladimir Vernadsky.

Ross has spoken at Schiller Institute conferences since 2013: in Frankfurt, in New York (including a 2017 conference hosted with the NYU Tandon School of Engineering) and online. Ross is a co-author of the Schiller Institute report “Extending the New Silk Road to West Asia and Africa”.

haidar-al-fuadi-al-atabe.standfirst: An Iraqi lawmaker on what cooperation with China could rebuild: ports, railways, power and water — and work for Iraq's young.
bio: Haidar Al-Fuadi Al-Atabe is a member of the Council of Representatives of Iraq. In March 2021, at the Schiller Institute's online conference “World at a Crossroad”, Al-Atabe spoke on cooperation between China and Iraq for the reconstruction of Iraq.

talks.title: The importance of China–Iraq cooperation for the reconstruction of Iraq

paras.text: I extend to you all our love and appreciation crowned with the most fragrant greetings of peace our most sublime prayers are for your success in this conference and thank you for inviting me to speak to you greetings to the international Schiller institute and its chairman chairwoman mrs Helga Zepp-LaRouche for convening this important conference in this very sensitive time and greetings to all esteemed guests we would like also to thank the member of the

Institute and administrator of the arabic language school of physical economics my brother and dear friend mr Hussein Askary for his intervention in the ongoing debate in Iraq regarding the reconstruction of the country and its economic development we have indeed benefited much from his interventions and proposals today we would like to discuss a number of important matters and problems for which they from which the structure of the Iraqi state suffers and among these

Issues is the condition of the infrastructure in Iraq and the venture nature of the Iraqi economy we will also point to the importance of activating the Iraqi Chinese framework of cooperation generally known in the media as the oil for reconstruction agreement there is a whole package of problems that haunt the Iraqi economy and the China agreement has many advantages in dealing with them advantages for the Iraqi people and their economy we believe these advantages are many

China Iraq agreement can be considered the key to reading Iraq of many of its suffocating social and economic crises I would like to deal with some of these today which are six but we'll discuss only two of them in depth due to the time restrictions among the problems Iraq is suffering from are the catastrophic

Deficit in infrastructure the huge rate of unemployment especially and the nature of the oil-dependent Iraqi economy the agreement can also help get rid of the corruption in the country it also facilitates connecting Iraq to the new silk road project one of the urgent matters is the

Catastrophic deficit in infrastructure airports roads railways power generation water and housing all these soft infrastructures such as healthcare education and scientific research Iraq and China can cooperate to build many projects in more than one sector of

Infrastructure we mentioned all all at once for example building the great port and roads and railways to and from it building power plants housing clusters factories water projects and sewage systems in more than one spot on the Iraqi map therefore we have to solve the infrastructure problem

Because it affects the social structure too and I believe this agreement will help pick Iraq out of these problems in the infrastructure the other very important matter today is the massive unemployment rate especially among the young segments of society which constitutes a major part of the population of Iran we believe that unemployment make those

Youth a ticking social bond and a reservoir of recruitment for extreme and perverted groups a clever and serious Iraqi negotiator should make it a condition of cooperation with China to employ a major ratio of the Iraqi workers and engineers in the projects undertaken by the Chinese companies inside Iran we all know that the Chinese worker and engineer today

Have a relatively high wage and enjoys stability and prosperity in their country and are not eager to work for a lesser wage and in a potentially challenging condition abroad therefore Chinese companies tend today to train the labor force in the host country does Iraq would be able to find employment for tens of thousands of the youth in these projects

Therefore we believe that the Iraqi Chinese agreement a key to find solutions to many big problems because the agreement will build for Iraq and its people the economic platform upon which the Iraqi economy will stand to move the wheels of the industrial as well as agricultural production and even vitalize the tourism sector to get rid of the reliance on the

Venture a single source of wealth as we argued earlier Iraq needs to Iraq needs a new economic structure this is the problem the Iraqi people are suffering from and their agreement we believe is very important for escaping the debacle in which the sons of our fine our people find themselves in our beloved finally I hope that Iraq will become a bridge for peace and

Cooperation among the regional and international powers not a wrestling ring where they fight we call on the united states of America and the other powers to respect the sovereignty and independence of Iraq an endeavor to cooperate with China and other powers to respect the global order and united nations charter on the basis of equality among all nations be they large or small and respect their sovereignty and independence of policy

Making but at the same time work jointly for peace economic development and mutual benefits I thank you for your attention and I wish you your confidence all success by the will of god we will see this framework of cooperation agreement implemented on the ground so that our
